periods.time: Seven Stars semifinal day and delayed final eve
periods.label: 以最弱必然击破厄运的无冕剑王

status.current: advances to the Seven Stars final against Stella after a one-day delay
status.condition: survives Amane's death result due to Kiriko's intervention; physically exhausted but awake for the final announcement
status.goal: fight Stella in the promised final

personality.summary: Gentle and forgiving yet uncompromising toward self-abandonment; he turns even a hated enemy's defeat into a chance to give courage.
values: stand as someone others can challenge

abilities_owned: manual heart control for sword acceleration

relationships.stella-vermillion: Fiancee and promised final opponent; he thanks her for saving Shizuku and is devastated when he thinks he missed their final.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Sister; he understands her feelings, thanks her for fighting for him, and is nearly killed by the effect she tried to prevent.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Enemy whose jealousy mirrors Ikki's own past despair; Ikki defeats him and then offers him a path to keep challenging.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Receives Amane's hidden past and motive from him, while suspecting Tsukikage's own agenda.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Older brother; Ikki watches Stella defeat him and still respects Ouma's severe pursuit of strength.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Saves him from the death-result curse after he collapses.
relationships.yuzo-kaieda: Authorizes the delayed final after Ikki wakes and shows will to fight.

periods.summary: Ikki trains overnight by cutting wood and iron with paper to refine Edelweiss-style energy control, preparing for Amane while Stella encourages him. Bakuya Tsukikage reveals Amane's original identity and life story, enabling Ikki to understand the hatred he senses. After Stella defeats Ouma, Ikki visits Shizuku and Alice, thanks Shizuku for fighting, and declares that only Amane cannot beat him. During the semifinal, he refuses to chase Amane if he withdraws, then provokes him by exposing his self-pity. In battle he faces luck-amplified sword strikes and ricocheting Azure blades, but uses clothing to catch the blades and embodied sword mastery to recover from every forced mistake. When Amane stops his heart, Ikki restarts it manually and cuts him down without using Ittou Shura. After Amane's post-defeat rampage, Ikki activates Ittou Shura anyway to save the venue and, more importantly, to give Amane a reason not to abandon himself. He defeats Amane's final self-made sword motion with the second secret sword Rekkou. Although a death result has grazed him, he initially seems fine, then collapses in the preparation room. Kiriko saves him, but he wakes a day late, believing he missed the final; Stella and the committee reveal everyone waited and Kaieda reschedules the final for the following night.

key_events.summary: Learns Amane's past and Tsukikage's request before the semifinal.
Thanks Shizuku and promises to inherit her will.
Defeats Amane's causality by making his swordsmanship a stronger inevitability.
Subdues Amane's post-defeat death-hand rampage with Ittou Shura and Rekkou.
Wakes late and accepts the rescheduled final against Stella.
